name: La salle des guichets
camera: from the back (south-east) corner of the hall, facing north-west: front door to the square on the LEFT wall, counter along the RIGHT

setting.walls: soft off-white plaster above white-and-cornflower-blue tiles
setting.landmark: the tall oak sorting cabinet of pigeonholes (back centre) and the brass-framed counter windows (right)
setting.light: cool daylight from the glazed blue door
setting.style: B15 La Poste: warm playful storybook painterly 3.5/5, cool neutral daylight

zoom_from.painted_as: the three brass-framed counter windows with the clerk, RIGHT wall
the tall oak sorting cabinet of pigeonholes, BACK CENTRE

note: The glazed blue door on the left wall is the way out to the square (hierarchy Back, no second painted control).

items.scene: A pigeon in a little cap pushes a letter into the big brass slot of the POST ("POST") OFFICE wall.
A postwoman reads the ADDRESS label pinned to A DRESS ("ah-DREHS") on the coat stand.
A LOP-eared rabbit ("ahn-vuh-LOP") sits hugging a giant ENVELOPE that leans against its paws.
Three penguins in woolly hats set off on an EXPEDITION ("ehk-spay-dee-SYOHN"), pulling a sledge of parcels toward the South Pole.
A boy in a green coat staggers under a PARCEL wrapped like a giant PACKET ("pah-KEH") of crisps.
A boy in a red coat jumps back in SHOCK ("SHOK") as a jack-in-the-box springs out of a parcel.
A girl COURIER ("koo-RYAY") zooms in on roller skates with a satchel full of MAIL.
A messenger boy hands a TELEGRAM to his GRAN ("tay-lay-GRAHM"), who smiles as she reads it.
A monkey shakes a TAMBOURINE ("TANBR") beside a giant postage STAMP on an easel that shows the very same tambourine.
A big blue-white-red FLAG DRAPES ("drah-POH") over the balcony rail above the counter.
